//: Generic: where finished videos are published. No app or location is named here.
An app's destination is the .env variable <env> (<APP> = the folder name under memory/features/
Its kind is recognised from that value by each kind's `match`. pipeline/publish.mjs uploads there,
only for a video whose state is done and only with the user's final approval (--approved).

google-drive-folder.upload: Drive API v3 resumable upload into the folder, as the signed-in user (GOOGLE_OAUTH_* in .env)
